value.answer: Messi, for me. He won the World Cup in 2022 and has been at the top of the game for almost two decades, which is hard to say about anyone else. Pelé and Maradona are the other names people fight over, and both have strong cases, but Messi's consistency across eras is what settles it for me. I can't check today's news or stats right now, but that doesn't change the pick.
